usedFor: Todoist holds tasks and Pushcut notifies your device, so “New Task Created in Project” can run “Send Notification”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist, then “Send Notification” in Pushcut
bestTemplate.why: A task added to a chosen project sends a smart notification to your device.

watchOut: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist is polling, so the notification arrives after a scheduled check.
